saved_evidence.exclusion_reason: A two-page question-and-answer sheet issued by Albuquerque Fire Rescue under Mayor Tim Keller and Fire Chief Emily V. Jaramillo. A public-information handout answering questions about one station, not a record of a decision, a standard or a study.

text_excerpts.1:
1 | P a g e 
 
 
City of Albuquerque     
Albuquerque Fire Rescue 
 
Timothy M. Keller, Mayor 
 
 
 
 
 
Emily V. Jaramillo, Fire Chief 
 
To: 
Government Affairs 
From: Emily Jaramillo, Fire Chief 
Re: 
Q&A Station 11 Remodel 
Date: 
August 27, 2025 
 
The remodel for Station 11 is one of my top priorities. It is part of a bigger Capital Outlay project that my 
administration requested to remodel several of our older stations to enhance privacy for firefighters. The 
other purpose for the remodel at Station 11 is to expand living quarters to accommodate moving a Medic 
Unit to Station 11. This will provide an additional resource to respond to our residents in District 11 and 
reduce the call volumes for Engine and Rescue 11. This is a proactive project to enhance the living 
quarters at our older fire stations; we want to reiterate that all AFR stations currently have ways to 
accommodate privacy for all firefighters and the goal of this project is to improve them and make them 
more structural.  
 
We also want to clarify the misinformation that women do not want to work at Station 11. Women have 
voluntarily bid to Station 11 in previous bids and the Station Captain for our most recent bid is a woman 
who chose to bid there. We have not received a complaint nor has a complaint been routed through our 
Union that woman firefighters do not want to bid to any of our stations because of the living quarters.  
 
The remodel at Fire Station 11 is a major renovation and has been in the design phase for about eight 
months. As with other major capital projects, there were some delays along the way including IT design 
and most recently DMD’s selection of our contractor. DMD selected Franken last week and AFR did a 
walk through with the contractor on August 26th. The tentative timeline for the renovations is as follows: 
1. AFR will receive a quote from the contractor within 2 weeks  
2. Plans will be finalized and submitted to permitting next week
